propositions: Provider qualification should be decided by membership in a known registry, not by shape pattern matching of prefixes
Explicitly configured providers must validate against KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and raise LLMConfigError with available names on mismatch
Unknown inline provider prefixes in model strings should fall back to unqualified treatment without raising, preserving multi-colon Bedrock ids intact
The static KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES frozenset replaces _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE and must contain exactly the 24 names from pydantic-ai's runtime registries
Slashed provider names (e.g., gateway/openai) must now correctly split as qualifiers, fixing prior shape-regex rejection of valid names
Test assertions recording infer_provider output for unregistered names (test, google_genai) must update to reflect None rather than accepting arbitrary identifiers
